anchor.phase: forward inference operator; framework prefill/decode routing is a separate gate
anchor.model: DeepSeek V4 mHC family; T4 Normal is a source-derived shape example, not an enumerated Mega test or production trace
anchor.tp_ep: not encoded by the Mega mHC API; must be fixed at a framework call site
anchor.dtype: BF16 x/residual/output; FP32 coefficients and Fn; optional FP8 E4M3 output
anchor.strides: API requires dense contiguous x, residual, coefficients, Fn and output; optional GEMM/shared scale factors use checked noncontiguous layouts

math.residual: R'[t,j,h] = x[t,h] · post[t,j] + Σ_i comb[t,i,j] · R[t,i,h]
math.coefficient_projection: flatten(Rℓ+1)·Fn^T → 24 logits; HC RMS scaling; group-specific affine then two independent branches: Pre/Post sigmoid (+Pre epsilon) and 4×4 Comb Sinkhorn
math.normal: Pre from current R' collapses four routes; BF16 rounding precedes RMSNorm and optional FP8 cast
math.shifted: previous Pre collapses current R'; new Pre is stored for the next step; RMSNorm waits for materialized BF16 and split statistics
math.source_basis: tests/test_mega_mhc.py:114-214; code below is a symbolic restatement, not a verbatim snippet

operator_graph.placement: Attention and FFN/MoE each sit inside an mHC boundary. A four-route residual state crosses those sublayers; each sublayer itself accepts and returns one H-wide activation. A V4.1 shifted boundary carries Pre from the previous boundary.

shapes.new_coefficients: Pre[4], Post[4], Comb[4,4] per token FP32

nodes.name: Collapse + RMSNorm
nodes.reads: Rℓ+1 与 Normal 的新 Preℓ+1 / Shifted 携入的旧 Pre
nodes.computes: 四路加权和 → BF16 舍入 → 输出 RMSNorm
nodes.writes: 下一子层 Fℓ+1 的 [T,H] 输入
nodes.dependency: Normal 等新 Pre；Shifted 用携入旧 Pre，不依赖本次新 Pre。两个模式都需要 Rℓ+1。

nodes.name: Attention 或 FFN/MoE
nodes.reads: mHC 输出的 [T,H] 归一化激活
nodes.computes: 下一子层 Fℓ+1：Attention 或 FFN/MoE；不属于本接缝 kernel
nodes.writes: 下一次接缝需要的 xℓ+1
nodes.dependency: 本图从已完成 Fℓ 的 xℓ 开始，到 Fℓ+1 输入结束。

nodes.name: 残差更新 Post + Comb
nodes.dependency: 子层 Fℓ 及所需 collective 完成后才能消费 xℓ。

nodes.name: 系数投影 + HC RMS
nodes.computes: 24 个点积 + 4H 平方和；汇总 split 后用 HC RMS 缩放
nodes.writes: 每 token 24 个归一化 logits
nodes.dependency: 归一化 logits 同时供 Pre/Post 分支与 Comb 分支；两分支无相互数据依赖。

nodes.name: 仿射 + sigmoid
nodes.reads: 前 8 个归一化 logits、Pre/Post 的 scale/base
nodes.dependency: Normal 的新 Pre 供本接缝 Collapse；Shifted 的新 Pre 留待下一接缝。与 Comb 是兄弟分支。

nodes.name: Sinkhorn 投影
nodes.reads: 后 16 个归一化 logits、Comb scale/base、ε 与迭代数
nodes.computes: Comb 仿射 → row softmax+ε → 列归一化 → 交替行/列归一化
nodes.dependency: 不读取 sigmoid 的结果；与 Pre/Post 分支共享投影输入，有限迭代得到近似双随机矩阵。

operator_graph.numerical_example: 单个 hidden 坐标的两路手算：R=[1,2]，x=3，Post=[0.5,0.25]，Comb=[[0.75,0.25],[0.25,0.75]]（行=旧路，列=新路），R′=[2.75,2.5]。此例只解释下标；固定 kernel 实际为四路。

edges.value: first 8 normalized logits; affine per group

predecessors.name: SGLang V4：Post 分离，Pre 做 split-K
predecessors.graph_nodes: Post 仍是独立阶段；Pre 路径优化了投影、平方和、split 汇总、激活/Sinkhorn、Collapse 与可选 Norm。
predecessors.reads: Post 读取旧 R、x、Post/Comb 并写 BF16 R′；Pre 重读 R′、FP32 Fn、scale/base 和可选 Norm weight。
predecessors.execution: 未开启 DeepGEMM 时，小/中 T 的 TileLang producer 以 [32 token, hidden block] × split-K 计算，写 [split,T,32] 投影与 [split,T] 平方和；big_fuse 再读 partial、汇总并产生系数和输出。开启 opt-in 时，tf32_hc_prenorm_gemm 负责 producer。big_fuse 可再折入 RMSNorm。
predecessors.hardware: TileLang stage 0 每 CTA 128 线程，以 shared BF16 输入/FP32 Fn tile 和 T.gemm 做流水计算；big_fuse 每 token 一 CTA、96 线程。编译后的 warp→MMA 映射未核实。
predecessors.tradeoff: split-K 给低 T 增加 producer CTA，也增加 FP32 scratch；Post 写出 R′ 后仍要被 Pre 重读，producer 与 epilogue 至少两次 launch。此处固定 V4 快照，不等于 V4.1 shifted 调用链。

predecessors.name: vLLM V4：小 T 的 FMA Post→Pre
predecessors.graph_nodes: T≤16 时，一次 launch 融合 Post 更新、投影 partial 和平方和 partial；split 汇总、激活/Sinkhorn、Collapse 仍在 mhc_pre_big_fuse。
predecessors.reads: 一个 CTA 对应一个 token、hidden split 和输出列 tile，读取旧 Post/Comb、x、旧 R 与对应 Fn 列。不同输出列 CTA 重复计算 R′，只有列 tile 0 写 R′ 和平方和。
predecessors.execution: Grid=(T,24/tile_n,split_K)，每 CTA 256 线程。每线程负责一组 hidden 坐标，计算四路更新与标量 FMA 点积，先 warp 内归约，再由 warp 0 写 FP32 partial。T>16 时 wrapper 改用分离 TileLang Post + DeepGEMM prenorm GEMM。
predecessors.hardware: 小 T producer 使用标量 FP32 FMA、warp 与 shared 跨 warp 归约，没有 Tensor Core GEMM。寄存器数、实际 occupancy 和访存量没有测量。
predecessors.tradeoff: 减少一次 producer launch，并立即复用本 CTA 算出的 R′；列 tile 之间重复更新、partial scratch 仍在。源码把 R′ 存为 BF16，却用局部 FP32 new_r 参与投影，与重读 BF16 R′ 的数值等价性还需单独验证。

predecessors.name: SGLang V4：小 T 的 FMA Post→Pre
predecessors.graph_nodes: T≤32 时融合 Post、投影 partial 与平方和 partial；big_fuse 仍汇总 split，计算 Pre/Post/Comb、Collapse 和可选 RMSNorm。更大 T 保留独立 Post；投影 producer 在 opt-in 开启时走 DeepGEMM，否则走 TileLang。
predecessors.reads: 一个 CTA 读取旧 Post/Comb、x、旧 R 与对应 Fn 输出列；只有输出列 tile 0 写 BF16 R′ 和平方和 partial。
predecessors.execution: Grid=(T,ceil(24/tile_n),split_K)，每 CTA 256 线程；每线程处理 hidden 坐标，算四路 FMA 更新、局部投影和 RMS partial，再做 warp 归约与 FP32 split scratch 写入。
predecessors.hardware: 小 T 使用标量 FMA 与 warp/shared 归约；更大 T 且 opt-in 开启时可选 DeepGEMM Tensor Core 投影。编译布局与 profiler 计数未知。
predecessors.tradeoff: 源码明确在投影前把新 R′ 舍入为 BF16，保留未融合 Post→Pre 的数值边界。输出列 CTA 仍重复更新计算；big_fuse 是下一次 launch。

fusion_atlas.question: 同一条 Post→下一 Pre 接缝，在各实现中究竟分成几次 kernel launch？
fusion_atlas.data_basis: conceptual; launch 分组和数据边界来自固定源码，不是 GPU 时间轴
fusion_atlas.what_to_read: 横向是算子类别，不是依赖或耗时；实色分组只表示同一次 launch 覆盖。先读 Normal/Shifted 分支图，再点实现查看执行细节。
fusion_atlas.conclusion: 早期融合主要消掉 Post→投影之间的一次 launch；Mega 把汇总、Sinkhorn 和输出 Norm 也纳入一次 launch，但内部仍有 scratch 与同步。

rows.boundaries: R′ BF16 写回并重读 → FP32 split partial → big_fuse；Norm 视 weight/变种而定。

rows.label: vLLM V4 · 小 T 融合

rows.label: SGLang V4 · 小 T 融合
rows.boundaries: R′ 在投影前 BF16 舍入；FP32 split partial → 第二次 big_fuse launch；Norm 可被 big_fuse 包含。

rows.label: DeepGEMM · Mega mHC

segments.label: 一个 launch 容器（不表示串行）· Normal / Shifted 依赖见上图

rows.boundaries: R′ 仍是输出状态；FP32 split partial 经 scratch 和跨 CTA barrier；Shifted 的输出读取旧 Pre，新 Pre 留给下一边界。

operator_implementation.early: SGLang V4 的独立 mhc_post_tilelang 写 BF16 R′；vLLM/SGLang 小 T 融合 CTA 直接读取 x、旧 R 与旧系数，并把更新和投影 partial 合算。
operator_implementation.mega: WG1–2 更新 R′，同时 WG0 准备系数 GEMM；R′ 还必须作为跨边界状态写出。

operator_implementation.early: SGLang 独立 Pre 使用 split-K 的 T.gemm 或 DeepGEMM；小 T 融合使用 256 线程标量 FMA CTA、warp/shared 归约，写 FP32 partial。不同输出列可能重复算 R′。
operator_implementation.mega: WG0 用 TMA 载入 Fn，以 TF32 UMMA 累加各 split partial；WG3 写 scratch；Mix 等全部 split。

operator_implementation.early: big_fuse CTA 读取 FP32 split partial，计算 HC RMS 和 24 个系数；其前 32 线程在小矩阵上处理 Post/Comb 与 Sinkhorn。
operator_implementation.mega: Mix worker 在同一次 persistent launch 中汇总 split partial、得到 Pre/Post 并执行 Sinkhorn。

operator_implementation.early: big_fuse 的其他线程读取 R′ 和 Pre，把四路压成一路；SGLang 可选 with_norm 变种继续算输出 RMSNorm。V4 当前 Pre 与 V4.1 carried Pre 是不同契约。
operator_implementation.mega: Normal 等本次 Mix 的 Pre；Shifted 使用携带来的旧 Pre，WG5 等 BF16 X1 和统计量到齐再做 Norm。

roles: WG0: TMA input/Fn + TF32 UMMA producer
WG1: residual update / Post worker A
WG2: residual update / Post worker B
WG3: split partials and barrier arrival
WG4: shifted Mix or normal worker
WG5: Norm worker; normal mode can reuse retired WGs
geometry.schedule: persistent grid of num_sms CTAs; task=(64-token block, hidden-K split); CTA takes task_idx=blockIdx.x + n·num_sms
geometry.mapping_note: Source names the six warpgroup roles and selected lane formulas. This conceptual map is not an interpreter trace or profiler timeline.

source_map.title: Gate and tensor contract
source_map.question: Which call shapes can reach Mega mHC?
source_map.what_to_read: SM100, route count, contiguous BF16/FP32 tensors and output checks
source_map.conclusion: This API is specialized; a framework must route other devices and formats elsewhere.

source_map.title: Split policy and scratch
source_map.question: How many hidden-K partitions are created?
source_map.what_to_read: deterministic 16-way mode, SM-aware maximum, per-stream barrier initialization
source_map.conclusion: Split count trades parallel producer work for FP32 partials and reduction.

source_map.title: Tile and workspace
source_map.question: What does one task contain?
source_map.what_to_read: 64 token rows, 64 hidden positions per route, 24 coefficient outputs and three FP32 partial arrays
source_map.conclusion: A task is one token block × one hidden-K split, with one or more 64-hidden iterations.

source_map.title: Persistent launch
source_map.question: How does the host launch work?
source_map.what_to_read: JIT specialization, num_sms grid and 768-thread CTA
source_map.conclusion: One launch contains persistent CTAs; launch geometry alone does not give occupancy or latency.

source_map.title: CTA and warpgroup assignment
source_map.question: Which split does CTA 0 first own?
source_map.what_to_read: uneven whole-block split formula and six static WG roles
source_map.conclusion: For the anchor, task 0 is token block 0, split 0 and hidden 0–63 on each route.

source_map.title: Separate TMA inputs
source_map.question: What enters the producer pipeline?
source_map.what_to_read: warp 0 reads residual and x, warp 1 reads Fn, warp 2 is the MMA worker
source_map.conclusion: The two TMA input branches feed the same coefficient GEMM.

source_map.title: Old coefficient TMA
source_map.question: When are prior Post/Comb/Pre coefficients loaded?
source_map.what_to_read: warp 3 stages Post and Comb for each task; shifted mode also stages carried Pre
source_map.conclusion: The coefficient reads are a separate input branch and repeat for each K split of a token block.

source_map.title: Residual update and UMMA
source_map.question: Where is the updated residual made?
source_map.what_to_read: WG1–2 use post/comb coefficients, compute route updates and feed A to TMEM
source_map.conclusion: Residual mixing and the coefficient GEMM are pipelined within a CTA.

source_map.title: Coefficient GEMM
source_map.question: Why a Tensor Core GEMM for only 24 outputs?
source_map.what_to_read: TF32 UMMA accumulator across K atoms and four routes
source_map.conclusion: Split-K exposes parallelism for a wide reduction, while 24 outputs stay a small N dimension.

source_map.title: Partial write and split arrival
source_map.question: When can Mix read a token block?
source_map.what_to_read: WG3 drains TMEM to FP32 scratch and signals Mix only after statistics and stores
source_map.conclusion: Mix waits for all splits; the reduction is inside the same kernel, not a second launch.

source_map.title: Split reduction and Sinkhorn
source_map.question: How are Pre/Post/Comb produced?
source_map.what_to_read: reduce 24 partial outputs, normalize by HC RMS, sigmoid Pre/Post and iterate 4×4 Sinkhorn
source_map.conclusion: This stage turns the partial GEMM into next-step routing coefficients.

source_map.title: Normal and shifted output paths
source_map.question: Which Pre coefficient normalizes the output?
source_map.what_to_read: normal mode reuses retired WGs; shifted mode uses previous Pre and a separate Norm barrier
source_map.conclusion: The two modes have different state lifetimes and cannot be collapsed into one naive formula.

source_map.title: Shifted Norm computation
source_map.question: What does shifted Norm wait for and calculate?
source_map.what_to_read: Norm barrier waits for BF16 X1 stores and split squared sums before RMS scaling and optional FP8
source_map.conclusion: The output uses carried Pre and a BF16 boundary before RMSNorm; current new Pre belongs to a later step.

source_map.title: Graph replay and split barriers
source_map.question: Why does replay need an epoch?
source_map.what_to_read: epoch tag prevents a CUDA Graph replay from accepting prior split completions
source_map.conclusion: Correctness depends on ordering across persistent CTAs, not just local warp synchronization.

source_map.title: PyTorch reference formula
source_map.question: What mathematical output does the kernel approximate?
source_map.what_to_read: new residual, coefficient GEMM, Sinkhorn, shifted versus normal Pre, and RMSNorm
source_map.conclusion: The reference defines the numerical boundaries used by the correctness test.

source_map.title: Reference and test coverage
source_map.question: What is tested, and what is still unmeasured here?
source_map.data_basis: source test design; not locally reproduced
source_map.what_to_read: correctness, deterministic repeat, graph capture/replay, two streams, shape matrix and kineto call
source_map.conclusion: The repository contains GPU tests; this case has no local SM100 results or comparable benchmark run.

source_map.title: Six workgroups, changing consumer roles
source_map.question: Which workers persist, and which roles change?
source_map.data_basis: CTA has six 128-thread workgroups; role retirement and consumer entry are separate.
source_map.what_to_read: Read role dispatch together with Normal/Shifted branches at L656–690.
source_map.conclusion: WG0 controls transfers and MMA; WG1/2 Post; WG3 drains partials. Consumer roles differ by mode.

source_map.title: Post lane coordinates and interleaved atoms
source_map.question: Which rows and hidden pairs does a Post lane own?
source_map.data_basis: BLOCK_M=64; four warps/WG; four lanes per row group; two rows/lane.
source_map.what_to_read: Trace row_indices, hidden_pair_idx and advance(kNumPostWGs).
source_map.conclusion: WG1/2 alternate 8-hidden atoms; a lane processes two rows and a pair of hidden values.

source_map.title: BF16 boundary, TMEM publish and statistics
source_map.question: Which representations of the updated residual are published?
source_map.data_basis: Post rounds to BF16 before projection, square sums and optional Shifted Collapse.
source_map.what_to_read: Follow stores, full_a, store_ready_io and full_stats; they protect different values.
source_map.conclusion: TMEM A, residual store and statistics have distinct consumers and readiness signals.

source_map.title: Residual store completion and independent Norm arrival
source_map.question: When can the IO slot be reused, and when is X1 visible?
source_map.data_basis: TMA-store wait precedes empty_io; Shifted stats precede Norm arrival.
source_map.what_to_read: Trace store_ready_io → tma_store_wait → empty_io, then mode-specific arrival.
source_map.conclusion: Store completion gates slot reuse; Shifted Norm arrival also includes X1 statistics.

source_map.title: MMA waits, reuse and accumulator commit
source_map.question: How do two operands and reusable slots constrain MMA?
source_map.data_basis: Fn ring per K block; A ring per 8-hidden atom; accumulator per split task.
source_map.what_to_read: Follow full_fn/full_a and release of empty_a/empty_fn; full_accum comes after the task.
source_map.conclusion: One 64-hidden block contains eight atoms and four route products per atom.

source_map.title: Normal consumer: one WG owns one token
source_map.question: Who runs Mix, Collapse and Norm in Normal mode?
source_map.data_basis: A shared ticket selects token; warp0 runs Mix; all four warps consume its Pre.
source_map.what_to_read: Follow token_idx, pre_coeffs, named barrier, retained BF16 X1 and the four-warp RMS reduction.
source_map.conclusion: Normal joins all split writes, rereads R′, and retains Collapse in registers; no global X1 is required.

source_map.title: Split barrier: release, acquire and replay epoch
source_map.question: What replaces a kernel boundary between producer and consumer?
source_map.data_basis: Each split arrives once; consumer waits for S arrivals under the current epoch.
source_map.what_to_read: Read init/wait_init, release arrival and acquire wait; distinguish Mix and Norm domains.
source_map.conclusion: Partial visibility is explicit; a single launch is not automatic cross-CTA synchronization.

steps.body: Collapse = 四路加权求和。Normal 用本次 Rℓ+1 预测的新 Pre；Shifted 用上一接缝已预测并携入的 Pre，本次预测的新 Pre留待下一接缝。两者是不同模型契约。

steps.title: 同一个状态，两项独立工作
steps.body: 这是 caller 的 Rℓ→两分支视角，与 Post 完成后投影 Rℓ+1 的接缝视角不同。

steps.title: 主流和 stats 流各自推进
steps.body: 主流消费携入 Pre 并执行子层，stats 流预测当前需要的新系数；二者可能争用资源。

steps.title: Post 是必须的汇合点
steps.body: Post 同时需要子层输出和系数。存在并发机会，不代表实际隐藏了多少延迟；必须用 trace 验证。

mega_walkthrough.mental_model: 一套驻留 CTA 内，让不同 worker 生产、搬运、投影与消费；内存边界和就绪条件仍由显式协议连接。

roles.name: 控制与矩阵乘
roles.read: warp0: R/x TMA；warp1: Fn TMA；warp2: UMMA；warp3: 系数预取与 R′ store
roles.normal: 静态角色结束 → Normal 消费池
roles.shifted: 保持控制角色直至结束

roles.name: 两组 Post worker
roles.read: 交替处理 8-hidden atom，更新四路 R′、平方和、TMEM A；Shifted 同时 Collapse
roles.normal: 各自结束 → Normal 消费池
roles.shifted: 各自结束 → Shifted Norm 队列

roles.name: partial 写回
roles.read: 从 TMEM 取 64×24 累加结果；写 global partial/HC 平方和并发布 Mix arrival
roles.shifted: 保持 partial 角色直至结束

roles.name: 按模式消费
roles.read: Normal：立即进入单 token 消费池；Shifted：每 warp 生成一个 token 的系数

roles.name: 按模式消费
roles.read: Normal：立即进入单 token 消费池；Shifted：立即进入 X1 Norm 队列
roles.shifted: 等 X1 + 平方和 → Norm

pipeline_states.io: K0 的 R/x 已到 shared
pipeline_states.fn: K0 的 Fn 已到 shared
pipeline_states.event: 两个输入流独立到达；Fn 到齐也不能跳过 A 的等待。

pipeline_states.fn: 保留给 K0 的八个 atom
pipeline_states.mma: 可消费 a0：四路依次累加
pipeline_states.event: WG1 生产偶数 atom，WG2 生产奇数 atom。A0/A1 是不同槽。

pipeline_states.io: 仍不能覆盖 K0 的输入槽
pipeline_states.event: 消费 a0 后 A0 可复用；这不释放整个 IO 槽，也不提交整份 accumulator。

pipeline_states.io: K0 的剩余 atom 继续处理
pipeline_states.fn: 八个 atom 完成后才释放
pipeline_states.event: 跨过 a1…a3：a4 再用 A0（atom mod 4）；旧 a0 未释放时必须等待。

pipeline_states.io: 全部 Post 完成 + store wait → empty_io
pipeline_states.fn: 最后 atom 消费 → empty_fn
pipeline_states.mma: 全部 K block 完成 → full_accum
pipeline_states.event: WG3 读出整份 split partial 后释放 accumulator。Mix 另等全部 S 个 split。

mega_walkthrough.boundary: 源码支持的先后关系与一种合法状态快照；不是测得的调度、同时执行保证或耗时。
